summary: One-lane GPU plus folded TPU: simulated together and timing-clean on the GW5A-25A

correctness.method: make -C sim/unit run-gpu-tpu runs a four-thread GPU arithmetic/store kernel and a one-row identity TPU GEMM, checks guarded switching and retained state; make -C sw/baremetal check-gpu-tpu repeats both workloads through an assembled RTL SoC. P&R establishes device fit, not physical execution.

org.atomix.metric.execute-cycles.method: the integration workloads prove correctness but are not the matched R2 benchmark

org.atomix.metric.total-cycles.method: not measured with the matched R2 workload

org.atomix.metric.work-items.method: the correctness run covers two different workloads

org.atomix.metric.configuration-bytes.method: the generated .fs is an ASCII pack artifact, not a measured configuration transfer

org.atomix.metric.lut-used.method: nextpnr post-pack Device utilisation, comparable to the maintained Primer role rows

org.atomix.metric.lut-available.method: GW5A-25A device capacity reported by nextpnr

org.atomix.metric.flip-flop-available.method: GW5A-25A device capacity reported by nextpnr

org.atomix.metric.dsp-used.method: equivalent GW5A DSP sites: 24 MULT12X12 consume 12 dual-MULT12 sites and 3 MULTALU27X18 consume 3 sites

org.atomix.metric.dsp-available.method: GW5A-25A has 28 large DSP sites; nextpnr reports either 28 MULTALU27X18 or 56 half-site MULT12X12 capacity

org.atomix.metric.maximum-frequency.method: nextpnr-himbaechel routed seed-1 report, clk_25mhz achieved 33.178501 MHz

org.atomix.composite-hard-role.hypothesis: A one-lane gpu-compute engine and folded TPU-lite can remain resident behind one role ABI and fit the GW5A-25A at 25 MHz.
org.atomix.composite-hard-role.success_criterion: Both native workloads pass in one RTL model; the loader profile places, routes, and achieves at least 25 MHz at seed 1.
org.atomix.composite-hard-role.result: PASS in simulation and P&R; no physical-board execution claim.
org.atomix.composite-hard-role.source_diff_scope: SHA-256 of the concatenated git --binary patches for components/role/{tpu-lite,gpu-tpu}, configs/{sim-gpu-tpu,tangprimer25k-runtime-gpu-tpu}.json, sim/unit/{Makefile,tb_gpu_tpu.cpp}, and sw/baremetal/{Makefile,include/role.h,examples/gpu_tpu.c}; documentation and evidence records are excluded.
